plan:
A lawyer wants a research question answered thoroughly. Break it into 3-8 distinct sub-questions that, answered together, answer the whole. Each sub-question must be self-contained (it will be researched on its own) and name the tools it should use.

TOOLS:
- "documents": semantic search over the firm's own indexed documents (contracts, filings, memos, correspondence)
- "case_law": search of published court opinions (CourtListener), with the relevant passage of each opinion read

Use "documents" for anything about the client's own facts, agreements or filings; use "case_law" for rules of law, standards and how courts have decided; use both when a sub-question needs the facts and the law.
